description: This file implements functions for outputting text with various decorations, including support for Markdown and console output, as well as functions for printing help sections and handling text formatting. It manages output styles, escape sequences, and conditional formatting based on environment and command-line switches.

methods.name: OutputString
methods.description: Outputs a string with specified text decoration and HTML escaping, handling Markdown and console output modes.

methods.name: PrintSectionHelp
methods.description: Prints a help section header, formatted for Markdown or plain text.

methods.name: PrintShortHelp
methods.description: Prints a short help line, with optional Markdown link formatting.

methods.name: PrintLongHelp
methods.description: Prints detailed help text with headings and optional Markdown formatting, handling nested sections and comments.
